parameters.query: SELECT test_name, variant, sends, responses, conversions, response_rate_pct, conversion_rate_pct, avg_response_score FROM v_ab_test_results WHERE sends >= 15 ORDER BY test_name, variant

SELECT p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name, p.title, p.company, p.industry, p.platform, p.public_fact FROM prospects p WHERE p.status = 'new' AND p.profile_score >= 6 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ab_tests ab WHERE ab.prospect_id = p.id AND ab.template_type LIKE 'outreach_%') LIMIT 40

SELECT id, template_type, variant, system_prompt, user_prompt, model FROM message_templates WHERE is_active = TRUE AND template_type IN ('outreach_linkedin','outreach_instagram') ORDER BY template_type, variant
